question: Which instrument is played by Amjad Ali Khan?
solution: The correct answer is __**Sarod**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • **Amjad Ali Khan** is a renowned Indian classical musician known for playing the **sarod** • **It is a **stringed instrument that is a key component of Hindustani classical music. • He is a is a member of the **Seniya gharana**, a musical lineage that has been influential in the history of Indian classical music. • Amjad Ali Khan has received numerous awards, including the **Padma Bhushan** (1989) and **Padma Vibhushan** (2001), two of India’s highest civilian honors.
